M3MSAT


M3MSAT is no longer on orbit


NORAD ID: 41605
Int'l Code: 2016-040G
Launch date: June 22, 2016
Source: Canada (CA)
Launch site: SRIHARIKOTA (SRI)
Decay date: 2025-12-19

M3MSAT is a Canadian satellite managed by the Canadian Space Agency and Defense Research and Development Canada, part of the country's Department of National Defense. The 187-pound (85-kilogram) craft will test a new antenna to monitor ship traffic from orbit, instrumentation aimed at detecting static energy build-up in satellite electronics to improve the health and safety of future space missions.
